# The 90s Club

The 90s Club is a Kerala kitchen and taproom in Electronic City, Bangalore. The taproom serves Flying Fox craft beer. Kerala food and Flying Fox craft beer under one roof at Millennium Plaza, Hebbagodi.

Address: Millennium Plaza, 396/48 Hosur Rd, Dadi Reddy Layout, Veerasandra, Hebbagodi, Electronic City, Bangalore 560100
Phone: +91 96321 48811
WhatsApp: +91 96321 48811
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the90sclubretropub
Hours: 12 pm–12 am every day
Parking: at Millennium Plaza
Seats: about 80, full AC
Geo: 12.8346301, 77.6793577
Google Maps: https://share.google/IelhjSarfxq2uls3r
Founders: Akhil and Sathish
Opened: February 2026
